prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle side-impact collision. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated the traffic signal had been green for their direction. Driver 2 was operating a pickup southbound and entered the intersection as the collision occurred, striking the driver's side of the sedan. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the right wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Both vehicles sustained significant damage and were not drivable. Skid marks were noted on the southbound approach. Driver 2 stated they did not see the sedan until impact and was cooperative throughout the investigation. Witness statements were collected at the scene. Citations are pending review of the signal timing data and witness accounts.
